title: Towards Order Fairness: Mitigating LLMs Order Sensitivity through Dual Group Advantage Optimization
title_zh: 迈向顺序公平：通过双组优势优化缓解大语言模型的顺序敏感性
authors: Xu Chu, Guanyu Wang, Zhijie Tan, Xinrong Chen, Ziyu Li, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
summary: The same evidence in a different order can change an LLM’s answer. DGAO combines within-group accuracy advantages with between-group stability advantages, training models to be both correct and consistent across input permutations.
summary_zh: 大模型对输入顺序的敏感性是序列建模架构固有的局限性之一：输入同样的证据，仅仅调整排列顺序就可能改变模型答案。DGAO 将组内准确性优势与组间稳定性优势结合，通过强化学习同时提升回答的正确性和对输入顺序的稳定性。

title: RADO: Reasoning Audit-Driven Optimization for Rigorous Reasoning in High-Stakes Domains
title_zh: RADO：以推理审计驱动优化，提升高风险领域的推理严谨性
authors: Zhijie Tan*, Xu Chu*, Guanyu Wang, Ziyu Li, Weiping Li, Tong Mo
summary: A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning. RADO uses a tool-augmented audit model to locate logical errors, refine a reward model through preference optimization, and guide policy training with rewards for both reasoning and answers.
summary_zh: 最终答案正确，并不代表推理过程严谨。RADO 利用可调用外部工具的审计模型定位逻辑错误，通过偏好优化改进奖励模型，再以兼顾推理过程与最终答案的奖励指导策略训练。

title: MuSe: Multi-Stage Graph Reasoning via Vision-Language Models
title_zh: MuSe：基于视觉语言模型的多阶段图推理
authors: Guanyu Wang*, Xu Chu*, Zhijie Tan, Xinrong Chen, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
summary: Large graph images are cluttered and hard to reason over. MuSe alternates reasoning with targeted subgraph sampling and visualization, progressively gathering the evidence needed for an answer; SFT and reinforcement learning teach the model how to explore.
summary_zh: 大型图(Graph)中的边和节点容易存在堆叠和遮挡，妨碍图推理。MuSe 交替进行推理、任务相关子图采样与可视化，逐步收集回答所需的信息，并通过监督微调和强化学习优化探索策略。

title: Accurate and Efficient Personalized Query Rewriting in Baidu Search
title_zh: 百度搜索中准确且高效的个性化查询改写
authors: Xu Chu, Angela Li, Jiaming Zhang, Wei Li, Zhijie Tan, Dawei Yin, Shuaiqiang Wang, Daiting Shi
summary: Personalized rewriting needs to infer user intent without slowing search. PicQue combines hybrid supervised fine-tuning with GRPO and guided search, retaining the benefits of reasoning while enabling short, direct query rewrites at inference time.
summary_zh: 个性化查询改写需要理解用户意图，同时满足在线搜索的低延迟要求。PicQue 将混合监督微调与 GRPO、引导搜索结合，保留推理带来的收益，同时在推理阶段直接生成简短的查询改写。

title: Residual Decoding: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via History-Aware Residual Guidance
title_zh: 残差解码：通过历史感知残差引导缓解大型视觉语言模型的幻觉
authors: Xinrong Chen*, Xu Chu*, Yingmin Qiu, Hengyuan Zhang, Jing Xiong, Shiyu Tang, Shuai Liu, Shaokang Yang, Cheng Yang, Hayden Kwok-Hay So, Ngai Wong
summary: During generation, language priors can pull a vision-language model away from image evidence. Residual Decoding aggregates historical token distributions with confidence weights and uses the resulting residual signal to guide the next token, without additional training.
summary_zh: 生成过程中，语言先验可能使视觉语言模型偏离图像事实。残差解码以置信度加权聚合历史词元分布，再用历史残差信号引导下一词元的选择，无需额外训练。

title: Domaino1s: Guiding LLM Reasoning for Explainable Answers in High-Stakes Domains
title_zh: Domaino1s：引导大语言模型在高风险领域给出可解释答案
authors: Xu Chu*, Zhijie Tan*, Hanlin Xue, Guanyu Wang, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
summary: High-stakes questions need explanations that can be examined. Domaino1s combines domain-specific reasoning fine-tuning with Selective Tree Exploration to search promising reasoning paths, and introduces PROOF-Score to evaluate the quality of the explanations.
summary_zh: 高风险领域的问题需要可供审查的解释。Domaino1s 结合领域推理微调与选择性树探索，搜索更优的推理路径，并提出 PROOF-Score，从推理完整性、领域安全性和事实准确性评估解释质量。

title: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Augmentation for Improving Dynamic Graph Learning
title_zh: 用于改进动态图学习的自适应时空增强
authors: Xu Chu*, Hanlin Xue*, Bingce Wang, Xiaoyang Liu, Weiping Li, Tong Mo, Tuoyu Feng, Zhijie Tan
summary: Recent edges in a dynamic graph may be noise rather than useful signals. STAA uses graph wavelets to identify noisy spatiotemporal changes, then applies random-walk diffusion to reduce their influence and improve graph learning.
summary_zh: 动态图中新出现的边未必更有价值，也可能只是噪声。STAA 通过图小波识别时空变化中的噪声，再利用随机游走扩散降低噪声边的影响，为动态图学习构造更可靠的增强结构。

title: Qwen Look Again: Guiding Vision-Language Reasoning Models to Re-attention Visual Information
title_zh: Qwen Look Again：引导视觉语言推理模型重新关注视觉信息
authors: Xu Chu*, Xinrong Chen*, Guanyu Wang*, Zhijie Tan, Kui Huang, Wenyu Lv, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
summary: Longer reasoning can weaken attention to the image. Qwen-LookAgain learns reflective reasoning through BRPO, then uses visual-token copying or routing to reconnect reflection with visual evidence and reduce hallucinations.
summary_zh: 推理越长，模型对图像的关注越容易变弱。Qwen-LookAgain 通过 BRPO 强化学习算法进行反思式推理，再利用视觉词元复制或路由，让反思过程重新接触视觉证据，从而减少幻觉。

title: GraphSOS: Graph Sampling and Order Selection to Help LLMs Understand Graphs Better
title_zh: GraphSOS：通过图采样与顺序选择帮助大语言模型理解图
authors: Xu Chu*, Hanlin Xue*, Zhijie Tan, Bingce Wang, Tong Mo, Weiping Li
summary: Turning a graph into text introduces choices about both the neighborhood and its order. GraphSOS learns question-relevant subgraph sampling and sequence selection, then uses graph chain-of-thought distillation to improve structural reasoning.
summary_zh: 将图转成文本时，采样哪些邻居、如何排列节点与边，都会影响模型表现。GraphSOS 学习与问题相关的子图采样和序列选择，并通过图思维链蒸馏增强模型对结构的理解与推理。

title: Order Matters: Exploring Order Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: 顺序很重要：探索多模态大语言模型的顺序敏感性
authors: Zhijie Tan*, Xu Chu*, Weiping Li, Tong Mo
summary: Can changing the order of images and text change a model’s answer? This study tests text, image, and mixed-modality permutations, revealing substantial sensitivity and limited transfer of good prompt orders across models.
summary_zh: 只改变图片和文字的排列，是否就会改变模型答案？这项研究系统测试文本、图像和图文混合顺序，揭示多模态模型显著的顺序敏感性，以及优良提示顺序在不同模型之间有限的迁移性。
